rows.verification: Private device baseline: reporter registers mask 0x4e replacing ElleKit mask 0x40; clone terminates EXC_GUARD while forwarding intercepted breakpoint. Preserving 0x40 allowed a 72-second offline run and diagnostic completion. Final production-equivalent A/B retest in progress; other backends and real crashes are unverified. Final offline A/B clones retain the dispatcher and remain alive beyond 102/131 seconds, respectively; numeric MobileGestalt fallback was also required for rendering. No online/account or crash-report forwarding acceptance claimed.
rows.fix: Keep Facebook inactive pending complete identity, storage and managed-network acceptance. Do not infer full crash-reporter compatibility from startup.

rows.surface: Sibling data-home file read/stat in two real Facebook clones on palera1n
rows.mechanism: OS home separation and restricted app entitlements were assumed to supply the filesystem boundary. Runtime public APIs disproved enforcement: both clones read the sibling canary. Production Facebook remains inactive and defaults-wire false.
rows.verification: 132 primary offline clone checks: 126 pass, six repeated foreign-file read/stat failures across B seed, A verify and B verify. System sandbox policy query denies the sibling path while actual read succeeds. Three source Keychain aliases and four defaults suites passed same-key canary isolation. Facebook later terminates in its framework. No full account, transport, cloud restore or MDM acceptance. The follow-up direct-syscall experiment reproduced foreign marker reads, then denied foreign content in both directions with a root-owned single-active permission gate. Foreign home metadata remains visible and closed-home sync fails; the candidate is not production-integrated (SGATE-001). Follow-up SGATE-002 integrates durable lifecycle enforcement: fresh A/B creation/sync, sealed export/deletion and both direct-syscall foreign-content denials passed. Foreign home root metadata remains visible; this verdict stays a gap.
rows.fix: Do not enable Facebook or advertise complete isolation. Require effective syscall-level boundary evidence on the supported device or a separately tested storage architecture; path hiding is insufficient.

rows.mechanism: The original descriptor-pinned permission experiment is now used by the durable SGATE-002 authority. The experiment alone is not a complete sandbox boundary; directory metadata and broader runtime acceptance remain unresolved.
rows.verification: Host: 40 targets, 120 selections, four authority revocations, 246 chmod fault positions, alias/hardlink/stale-inode cases. Actual A/B clones: own raw reads succeed; foreign Foundation/POSIX/raw reads denied in both directions; each run retains a FAIL for observable sibling root metadata. Closed-home sync fails. Main execute-bit removal blocked the tested launch, while bundle-directory-only closure did not. 2026-09-30 directory-only logical-profile primitive: 41,574 host filesystem assertions including 40 profiles/120 selections, revocation and 82 chmod faults PASS; existing 50,386 clone primitive assertions PASS. A private manual Instagram trial denied the previously witnessed A canary through both normal open and libc syscall as UID 501. Exact inode/ownership/mode were restored. This does not fix the automatic recovered switch, invalidate retained descriptors or prove shared/broker isolation.
rows.fix: Do not integrate into existing user profiles until durable ownership, global process closure, startup/cancellation, sync/delete and backup/export/rollback are covered by actual lifecycle tests. Repeat device content, metadata and alternative-launch probes. Do not mark DEVISO-001 covered.

rows.surface: Durable storage ownership, single-active admission, closed sync/delete and private IPA staging
rows.mechanism: Root-only receipts bind exact registered clone code/home inodes. Process coordinator seals all app families before drain, authorizes one selected clone only under its current reservation, and reseals on failure. Closed-home sync/deletion require a matching receipt and OS identity. Code-only staged copies regain executable modes beneath private transaction roots.
rows.verification: Host authority: 10,354 assertions; staged executable 23; primitive 50,386 including 40 entries and 120 selections. Physical: two fresh actual Facebook clones created/synced, both final verify runs 38 PASS/1 FAIL (observable sibling root metadata), own direct syscall markers retained, foreign Foundation/POSIX/raw reads denied. Prior pair closed export and scoped installer deletion passed. Final rootless upgrade and a second daemon restart complete startup recovery with both existing Reddit containers preserved, empty operation fence and CLOSED network. No online, account or 40-real-clone acceptance claimed. First production upgrade exposed the old three-second startup budget failing the second registered family drain. The actual dispatcher-budget regression failed first; shared aggregate stop budget now includes all registered families and remains capped by operation deadline. Final physical retest passes startup recovery after upgrade and another daemon restart.
rows.fix: Complete actual closed sync, export, deletion, relaunch and sibling direct-syscall tests on the supported device before enabling Facebook. Directory metadata, system-service backing stores, launch races and wider acceptance remain separate.
